name: California State Parks Free Fourth Grade Pass
description: California State Parks' Free Fourth Grade Pass (formerly the Adventure Pass) gives California public school fourth graders and their families free entry to 54 state parks, as part of the Outdoors for All initiative.
fullDescription: California State Parks' Free Fourth Grade Pass (formerly the Adventure Pass) gives California public school fourth graders and their families free entry to 54 state parks, as part of the Outdoors for All initiative.
whatTheyOffer:
- Unlimited free vehicle entry to 54 participating state parks
- For fourth graders attending a California public school
- Covers the student plus everyone in the same car (up to three adults)
- Valid from August of the fourth-grade year through August 31 of the following year
howToGetIt: A parent or guardian creates a free account at ReserveCalifornia.com and downloads the pass (available starting August 1 each year). Print the pass or show it on your phone to park staff at a participating park.
keywords: Free Fourth Grade Pass, Adventure Pass, 4th graders, fourth grade, state parks, free day use, Outdoors for All, family pass, children
